{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the sites after deduplication
print("Unique sites after deduplication:", df_dedup['site'].unique())
print("Number of unique sites after deduplication:", df_dedup['site'].nunique())

# Check the cross-tabulation of site and severity
print("\nCross-tabulation of site and severity:")
print(pd.crosstab(df_dedup['site'], df_dedup['severity']))

# Calculate response rate per site
table = pd.crosstab(df_dedup['site'], df_dedup['responded'], normalize='index')
print("\nResponse rate per site (proportion who responded):")
print(table)

# Extract the response rate for each site
response_rates = table[1]  # Proportion responded (responded = 1)
print("\nResponse rates:")
print(response_rates)

# Find the site with the highest response rate
highest_site = response_rates.idxmax()
highest_rate = response_rates.max()

print(f"\nSite with highest response rate: {highest_site} ({highest_rate:.3f})")"}
